definition: A requirement that content be readable, accessible, and offer an alternate contact method.
name: Accessibility Requirement

definition: A technical drawing of equipment.
name: engineering drawing

definition: A procedure's catalog entry.
name: register entry

definition: Operational instructions for a software procedure.
name: runbook

definition: A controlled document stating how a procedure is performed.
name: standard operating procedure

definition: Recorded instruction.
name: training media

definition: Rolling software out without manual steps.
name: automated deployment

definition: Reviewing work against a regulation or control and recording evidence.
name: compliance review

definition: Checking output against quality criteria.
name: quality control

definition: Assigning a risk class to a change or situation.
name: risk scoring

definition: Confirming a result meets its specification.
name: validation

definition: Governing how changes reach production.
name: Change Control

definition: A requirement that a communication only be sent to a recipient with active, recorded consent.
name: Consent Requirement

definition: A control preventing ledger entries after the period close boundary without an approved reopening.
name: Cutoff Control

definition: Every activity that keeps people safe from live or stored energy while they work on equipment.
scope_note: Use for the whole family of energy-control activities; use a narrower concept for a specific activity.
name: Hazardous Energy Control

definition: A requirement that evidence of an action remain retrievable for a fixed retention window.
name: Evidence Retention

definition: A control requiring a human, not an automated agent, to confirm an approval.
name: Human Approval Gate

definition: Releasing pressure stored in a hydraulic accumulator before isolation.
scope_note: Use only for machines fitted with an accumulator.
name: Accumulator Bleed-Down

definition: Disconnecting, closing or blocking each energy source of a machine.
name: Energy Isolation

definition: A requirement that employment counsel approve a legal or privacy commitment before it ships.
name: Legal Review Gate

definition: A person's family name, copied from FOAF.
name: family name

definition: A person's given name, re-homed from FOAF.
name: given name

definition: Relates a resource to a version of it.
name: has version

definition: A person's surname, re-homed from FOAF.
name: surname

definition: Isolating equipment from its energy sources and holding it isolated with personal locks and tags.
scope_note: Use for the procedure as practised; not for the compliance document.
name: Lockout/Tagout

definition: A requirement that a message include approved opt-out language.
name: Opt-Out Requirement

definition: The plant's own definition: inspecting parts after a changeover.
name: quality control

definition: An assessment of how a change affects personal data handling. Defined, not yet applied to any Requirement.
name: Data Privacy Impact

definition: A requirement restricting delivery to a defined local-time window.
name: Quiet Hours Restriction

definition: A control requiring a material account to reconcile or carry an approved exception.
name: Reconciliation Control

definition: A tagged build copied to production by an engineer.
name: Release

definition: The human decision at the release gate to approve or reject a release.
name: Release Approval Review

definition: Scoring a change's risk class before approval.
name: Change Risk Classification

definition: Approves production releases.
name: release manager

definition: Confirms zero-energy states.
name: plant safety officer

definition: Performs lockout and maintenance.
name: maintenance technician

definition: Returning production to the previous release, automatically when health checks fail.
name: Rollback

definition: A control requiring the preparer and the final approver of an action to be different agents.
name: Segregation of Duties

definition: In force and to be followed.
name: active

definition: No longer to be followed; kept for the record.
name: deprecated

definition: Being written; not to be followed.
name: draft

definition: Support is looking into a reported issue.
name: investigating

definition: A requirement that an external vendor attest to a control. Defined, not yet applied to any Requirement.
name: Third-Party Attestation

definition: Confirming at every isolation point, at most twice, that no energy remains, by the safety officer.
scope_note: Use for the check after isolation; not for the try-out at restart.
name: Zero-Energy Verification
